summary: Built rung-1 query-by-text retrieval. daemon.js: factored scoreNodeAgainstTokens(node, qt) from the existing scoreMatches/suggestToks/SUGGEST_STOP scorer + added GET /search?q=&k= scoring ALL nodes (incl. [ingest] note nodes) over label+summary, returning top-k {key,title,summary(≤200),score,kind} (default k=5). lib/mcp-core.js: added search_knowledge {query,k?} tool GETting /search. New test/search-knowledge.test.js (5/5 pass); autowire regression 15/15 (shared scorer intact). All files node --check clean. Daemon NOT restarted (route needs restart to go live), NOT committed. Dry demo: query "workspace hijack cwd" ranks the relevant [ingest] note at 0.548 (3 shared tokens) vs 0.000 for all irrelevant nodes.
